title: TEC stops: wheelchair accessibility
description: Bus stops of TEC (LETEC) in Wallonia with the GTFS wheelchair_boarding value per stop: accessible (about 3,800), not_accessible (about 26,800) or unknown. From the static GTFS feed on data.belgianmobility.io, refreshed daily. Search by stop name or near a point.
access_note: Open data; reuse must cite 'Source: <operator> – Open Data – <date of dataset update>' (given in each response's provenance).
